help_content.title: Nutrition Science & Guidance
help_content.overview: These targets are based on ISSN guidelines and sports nutrition research tailored to your activity parameters. Values are calculated using validated formulas for endurance performance and recovery.
help_content.pre_run: Pre-activity fueling optimizes energy stores while preventing GI distress. Emphasize easily digestible carbohydrates (1-4g/kg body weight), limit fat and fiber, and maintain hydration. Timing: 1-4 hours before exercise for optimal absorption.
help_content.during_run: During-activity nutrition maintains blood glucose and delays fatigue during longer efforts. Target 30-90g carbs/hour based on intensity and gut tolerance. Multiple transportable carbs (glucose + fructose) optimize absorption for activities >2.5 hours.
help_content.post_run: Post-activity nutrition accelerates glycogen replenishment and muscle protein synthesis. The 'anabolic window' emphasizes rapid carb intake (1.0-1.2g/kg) with high-quality protein (20-25g) within 30 minutes of completion.
help_content.validation: Warning indicators show values outside research-backed ranges but won't prevent plan creation. Individual tolerance varies - use these as starting points and adjust based on training responses.
